package: K03 partial: guarded critical-path npm entrypoint
scope: The integration rehearsal uses synthetic Prisma, storage, and notification boundaries. No external provider or production service was contacted.
finding: The public npm script previously bypassed scripts/test-critical-path.mjs and invoked Vitest directly. It now uses the guard, which verifies both required suites contain only executed passing tests. The harness models the best-effort support notification and asserts it is created, avoiding a swallowed fixture error that was previously printed to stderr.
